Hon'ble Karunesh Singh Pawar,J.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant and learned A.G.A. for the State as well as perused the record.
The present bail application has been filed by accused-applicant seeking bail in Case Crime No.459 of 2022, under Sections 366, 376 I.P.C., P.S. Nighasan, District Lakhimpur Kheri.
It is alleged in the first information report that on 29.05.2022 at about 10:00 pm, co-accused Ajay enticed away the informant on the pretext of marrying her with the applicant.

Munna took her on motor-cycle to her enclosed place at Malpur, P.S. Bheera where she was raped and kept on giving Munna vs State Of U.P. Thru.Secy. Home Lko. on 16 February, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/29005733/

sentences.text: Again on 30.05.2022, she was raped by Munna in front of shop near Sharda Nagar for the entire night.
On 31.05.2022, she was left near the mazaar where Ajay was already standing.
Learned counsel for applicant submits that statement of the victim under Section 161 Cr.P.C. is at variance with her statement under Section 164 Cr.P.C.
They do not inspire confidence, victim stayed with the applicant for a period of three days.
She was a consenting party.
The F.I.R. has been lodged after delay of eight days without assigning any reason.
Applicant has no criminal history and is in jail since 05.07.2022.
There is no corroborative evidence in support of the prosecution case.

Lastly,
it is contended that on the similar allegation, the Investigating Officer has dropped the name of the co-accused without assigning any specific reason.
It is just a case of false implication.

Learned A.G.A. has opposed the bail prayer however, could not assign any cogent reason on account of name of the co-accused against whom the similar allegations were levelled has been dropped by Investigating Officer while filing the charge-sheet.

On due consideration to the submissions advanced, perusal of the record as also the fact that the applicant is languishing in jail since 05.07.2022 having no criminal history, statement of the victim under Sections 161 & 164 Cr.P.C. and the fact that name of co-accused Ajay has been dropped while filing the charge-sheet, lack of corroborative evidence and period of incarceration gone into by the applicant, without expressing any opinion on merits of the case, I find it to be a fit case for enlarging the applicant on bail.
Accordingly, the bail application is allowed.

Let the applicant Munna be released on bail in aforesaid case crime number subject to his furnishing a personal bond and two reliable sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial court concerned with the following conditions:
(i) The applicant will not tamper with the evidence during the trial.
(ii) The applicant will not pressurize/ intimidate the prosecution witness.

(iii) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
(iv) The applicant shall file an undertaking to the effect that he shall not seek any adjournment on the dates fixed for evidence when the witnesses are present in court.
In case of default of this condition, it shall be open for the trial court to treat it as abuse of liberty of bail and pass orders in accordance with law.
